response.overview: Kairi, an ordinary high school girl, has come to see the first-ever live concert of her best friend, Sakine—who is also an idol. However, she discovers that Sakine has fled the venue just before the show. Kayama, Sakine’s manager, cannot afford to leave a gap in the performance lineup and schemes to put Kairi on stage as Sakine’s stand-in. Although Kairi has absolutely no experience with singing or dancing, she finds herself unable to refuse and agrees to take on the role. Kayama, a former idol herself, attempts a "Spartan" training regimen to drill the singing and dancing into Kairi, but Kairi struggles to pick up the moves. Desperate, they enlist the help of RIG-TAG, a popular idol group led by Kanon. With only four and a half hours until the curtain rises, will Kairi manage to take the stage in Sakine’s place? And will the runaway Sakine return? A long, eventful day for the two of them is about to begin!
response.title: 歌って！
